notes.title: New Map Announcement!
notes.content:
Happy to announce that we have started working on our next map, based on the [b]Battle of Wizna[/b], which happened almost immediately after the Battle of Westerplatte. 

[b]Brief Intro of the Battle : [/b]
The Battle of Wizna was fought between September 7 and September 10, 1939, between the forces of Poland and Germany during the initial stages of the Invasion of Poland. Because it consisted of a small force holding a piece of fortified territory against a vastly larger invasion for three days at great cost before being annihilated with no known survivors, Wizna is sometimes referred to as a Polish Thermopylae in Polish culture.

Remember: You can submit map requests over here. 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/412210/discussions/0/3273564671169058275/]LINK[/url]

notes.title: Re-starting Development with Alpha 5.0
notes.content:
Hi,

The creation of Warfront Defenders has been difficult. Due to a variety of causes, this project has been very meaningful to us. As a result, rather than abandoning it, we chose to revisit it with revisions.

This was a long-ago endeavor. From the Steam Greenlight era. Also, with little material. However, we were startled to see that people continue to play and broadcast it. That was sufficient motivation for a small studio like ours.

And we chose to give back to the community much more than we received in support.

The game was intended to be a single-map mini-game. Warfront Defenders-Westerplatte was the game's title. We choose to expand the mini-game into a full-fledged game with many levels. We want to release the game with all existing material and more stuff. Following that, we want to regularly update the game with new rogue-lite levels.

As a result, we modified the name to incorporate the additional levels and future additions.

Warfront Defenders

This game will be updated on a regular basis. And new levels with fresh battles will be released on a regular basis. Each addition will result in a little increase in the game's price to cover development expenses.

Many thanks, and we hope you like the latest version.

[b]Also, please drop your suggestions for new maps over here. 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/412210/discussions/0/3273564671169058275/]Drop your suggestions on this thread[/url]
Maps can be inspired by WW2 battles (our primary choice) or from other battles of history as well. [/b]

Bug fixes with this update:
The game progression is changed from day to day to rogue-lite with unlimited replayability.
Friendly soldiers freezing and Enemies firing through walls.
Bug in the tower placement tool
Bug in sniper weapon
Shelling Bug.

notes.title: Reviews Needed!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Don't forget, if you have any thoughts about the game (good or bad), to please drop a review on the store page! 

Reviews really help developers to get a feel for how the game should progress with development, areas that need refining and so on. Not to mention, it also helps a game to boost its sales and reach more customers when there's a significant amount of reviews!

Just a couple of minutes, that's all it takes, and doing so really helps us out.

notes.title: Update: New Input Manager and Custom Keybinding, UI upgrades
notes.content:
Patch Log:
[list]
[*] Control key bindings can be remapped from settings
[*] Bug in Unity's Input Manager, Implement new input manager.
[*] Previously it was unclear when the group is selected only 1 soldier has a diamond above its head. Now group selection has markers over each head.
[*] Pathfinding bugs
[*] Easier to move a large group of soldiers. 
[*] Bombzone animation
[*] In the tutorial, you can click on the dialogue box instead of the triangle.
[/list]

Please let us know if you have any feedback, suggestions or bugs and we'll be sure to read everything and do everything we can to develop this game into something great that you will all enjoy!

notes.title: Hotfix: Camera Edge detection issue
notes.content:
Hey everyone, the first update for Warfront Defenders: Westerplatte is here!

Patch Log:
Fixed an issue of camera scrolling off screen due to edge detection. 
In future builds, the edge detection will be optional and configurable.

Thanks for playing and if you have any feedback/bug reports please don't hesitate to let me know!
